name: Côtes de Bordeaux

limits: For red wine, Carmenère: at most 10%
For white wine, Colombard and Ugni Blanc together: at most 15%
For red wine, Petit Verdot: at most 15%

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc and Malbec sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.

blurb.text: A large Bordeaux-area appellation for red wine from grapes such as Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon and Malbec. White wine is made only under the Blaye, Francs and Sainte-Foy names.

sources.name: Candiago et al. 2022, A geospatial inventory of regulatory information for wine protected designations of origin in Europe, Scientific Data (product specifications as of 2021)
